title: File:Sunset Over Milad Tower.jpg
author: Salehi1990mohsen
description: Milad Tower, located in Tehran, Iran, is the sixth tallest tower in the world at 435 meters (1,427 ft). It serves as a telecommunications and observation tower and is a prominent symbol of Tehran’s skyline. Due to the vast distance from the shooting location, the sun appears even larger than Milad Tower as it sets, creating a dramatic silhouette of the tower against the evening sky
